name: query-explain
description: /explain-query runs EXPLAIN on your local database and explains the plan in plain words.

analyze.title: Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE
analyze.description: Really run read-only SELECT queries (in a read-only session, 60 s cap) to get measured times and row counts. Off: estimates only, nothing runs.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model that explains the plan: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id.
